EVERY IN-SCOPE REQUIREMENT WITH ITS AUTHORED CHECK. 226 checks green in trunk at the last promotion (dda426e). Grouped by how the check DECIDES, because the point of this state is to push toward mechanical and leave an honest residue.

== MECHANICAL, PROPERTY-CLASS — the three promoted from the spikes ==
These assert over the WHOLE machine rather than over an example, and that difference is the reason they were promoted.

R30 every gate collects its review → 'every gate in the machine collects all four review rounds'. Compiles the real machine, walks every state of kind gate, asserts all four fields present AND required. Not two gates we remember — all of them. The rounds were required in writing for this project's entire history and filled in zero gates, because nothing ever asserted this.

R31 a reopen re-activates without stranding → TWO properties, generated across every state the systematic machine actually walks.
  'reopening ANY state leaves the walk able to reach its gates' — for every reopened state, every downstream join fed from OUTSIDE the cone must have its fuel restored where the source is still done.
  'a reopened state completes and MOVES ON' — no state may have fuel waiting for it while it is already active.
  VERIFIED AGAINST ITS OWN BAR, which was 'written yesterday, it catches today's two bugs': with the re-arm disabled it fails, naming a stranded join; with the self-fuel guard disabled it fails twice, naming a state that re-activates itself; with both in place, green. That is not an inference — both fixes were switched off in turn and the runs recorded (run-dc658660000e).

R3/R5 ref search returns well-formed records → 'a binary file cannot produce a malformed record in a ref search'. Builds a repository containing a binary, searches a ref, asserts every record has a real path and a real line number and that no binary notice arrives as a record. Pins a flag that currently looks like a tidy default; without it version-control grep emits a line with no field structure at all.

== MECHANICAL, SOURCE-CLASS ==
Q14 the system does not disrupt its operator → 'no spawn in the engine or its binaries can pop a console window'. Scans every engine and binary source for spawn calls lacking the hide flag. Earned itself on first run by catching the one call site a hand sweep had missed — the most frequently called of all. A check over source, written in minutes, converting a property that depended on everyone remembering into one that depends on nothing.

== MECHANICAL, EXAMPLE-CLASS — authored earlier this iteration and green ==
R1, R2 partial read and oversize refusal · R3 context in one call (three checks) · R4 glob and list-only · R5, R6 ref search and ref read · R7 declared roots · R8 required args, including that an explicitly empty value is ACCEPTED — the distinction whose absence turned the guard into workaround pressure · R10 no-match said plainly · R11, R12 batch and atomicity · R16-R19 lint registry, decide-or-defer, facts behind refusals · R22-R25 hash in the grant, annotated tags, branch deletion, push configuration · R26, R27 config lane with secrets masked · R28, R29 bounds and containment · R33 promotion under its four rules (six checks) · R34 an empty verification run is FAILED · R35 an ambiguous root refuses.

== REVIEW-CLASS RESIDUE, and why each stays there ==
R36 identifiers are expanded where they are read — constrains PROSE addressed to a person. A check could only count words. Claiming a mechanical verdict here is the unearned label R20 exists to forbid.
R38 interruption is reserved for decisions — constrains WHEN a person is paged, which is policy over an existing channel.
R13 the product has one writer — partially mechanical (the file lane is tested); the 'detect a mutation by any other lane' half is review-class today.
R20 computed and asserted are distinguishable — the recording is checked; whether the distinction is USEFUL depends on how much is computable, which is the blocked cause below.

== DEFERRED, one cause, named rather than counted three times ==
R14 guidance reaches the packet, R15 guidance volume, R37 unattached rules are reportable. All three wait on the applicability selector, whose spike did not run. Two further checks named at M5 — every function allocated exactly once, every interface declared at both ends — are blocked by the SAME cause: functions, elements and items are prose in evidence rather than nodes.
  The lint registry already returns DEFER with the reason for the checks in this class rather than PASS, so the deferral is visible in the record instead of reading as coverage.

== THE DEMONSTRATIONS ==
D1 the killer sequence — exercisable, and largely exercised: this milestone read the register by range, read superseded evidence, and searched refs, all through the lane. The clean end-to-end run belongs at M8.
D2 a gate reviews itself to a REOPEN, the states re-walk, the gate then passes, and the superseded evidence stays readable — ALREADY OCCURRED TWICE, unplanned, at gate_inputs and gate_candidates. The strongest evidence in the iteration, and it was not staged.
